# fmc_distinguished_names (Data Source)

This data source reads the Distinguished Names.

The following restrictions apply:
  - Minimum FMC version: `7.4`

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fmc_distinguished_names" "example" {
  items = {
    "my_distinguished_names" = {
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain` (String) Name of the FMC domain
- `items` (Attributes Map) Map of Distinguished Names. The key of the map is the name of the individual Distinguished Name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `distinguished_name` (String) The value of the distinguished name, provided as comma-separated attribute-value pairs (for example `CN=example.com,OU=IT,O=Example,C=US`).
- `id` (String) Id of the Distinguished Name object.
- `type` (String) Type of the object; this value is always 'DistinguishedName'.
